messages:
Priya (Design): quick spot-check of the embeddings export flow and preview UI. Two pain points: export copy is vague and the preview table gets heavy on narrow screens. Thoughts?
Marco (Eng): agree. for preview we should collapse vector columns behind one cell like `Vectors (768)` with an expand chevron. avoids scrolling horizontally and DOM churn.
Hana (A11y): collapsing is fine if the expand control has `aria-expanded` and a keyboard shortcut. ensure expanded content is reachable by keyboard and announced.
Priya (Design): copy suggestions: change modal title to `Export vectors (CSV)` and clarifying subtext: `Includes id, truncated dims, rerank_score, optional vector columns`. Add an advanced toggle for `Compressed base64` export.
Dev (PM): product ask: add an export-size gauge in the modal that warns when >10k rows with a recommendation to sample. also log analytics for export_type and sample_method.
Kofi (ML): sampling presets: `First N`, `Random N (default 1000)`, `Stratified by score buckets`. For stratified show expected counts per bucket and a tiny preview sparkline of score distribution.
Hana (A11y): sparklines need alt text and an accessible label like `Score distribution: low to high`. avoid tooltip-only info; mirror it with sr-only descriptions.
Marco (Eng): implementation notes: background export job for big files (>5k). modal should say `Export started 1 email when done` and provide a download link when ready. Use a polite `aria-live` region to announce start and completion.
Priya (Design): UI detail: put export actions in the sticky header of the preview so users don't lose context when they scroll. on mobile compress to a single overflow menu.
Hana (A11y): sticky header must preserve logical tab order. overflow menu items need clear labels and `aria-haspopup` where appropriate. close buttons use `aria-label=\"Close\"`.
Marco (Eng): perf: cap in-table preview rows at 200 and show a banner: `Showing 200 of 25,430 vectors. Export will include all unless sampled.` Banner should be dismissible and use `role=note`.
Kofi (ML): rerank score cells: show raw value and an optional percentile toggle. default raw, but percentile often helps product people. Add an sr-only note describing range `0 to 1`.
Priya (Design): tiny copy tweak for export presets: `Save as preset` CTA and a short name field. helpful for repeated exports.
Dev (PM): tracking: emit event when user saves a preset and when they choose compressed vs expanded vectors.
build-bot: preview deployed for branch `feature/export-presets` 1 staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/export-presets
Marco (Eng): request for folks to smoke test with VoiceOver/NVDA and try a large export flow. I'll attach a PR checklist.
Hana (A11y): I'll run accessibility checks after PR. blocking if live region/modal-focus handling is missing.
Priya (Design): thanks all, I'll update the mocks and add notes to the design doc. :thumbsup:
